description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

DeNOVO Solutions, LLC provides technical and professional services to the Intelligence Community. The company is seeking a Junior Developer to support mission-focused software applications using geolocation principles, modern programming languages, microservices, containerization, and software testing. The role involves collaborating with developers, troubleshooting applications, and supporting customer requirements.
Junior software developer building geolocation applications and maintaining tested microservices in containerized environments

Responsibilities:
• Develop and maintain software applications that apply geolocation principles and support mission requirements
• Collaborate with team members using Git-based workflows, including branching, merging, and pull requests
• Assist with software testing, debugging, troubleshooting, and improving application reliability
• Contribute to software solutions involving microservices and containerized environments
• Work collaboratively with developers and other team members to support customer requirements

Requirements:
• Strong knowledge of and experience with geolocation principles and practices
• Customer domain knowledge
• Strong knowledge of Git version control, including branching, merging, and pull requests
• Experience working in collaborative team environments
• Familiarity with microservices architecture concepts
• Basic understanding of containerization technologies such as Docker
• Knowledge of software testing principles and practices
• Strong problem-solving, troubleshooting, and debugging skills
• Excellent communication skills and a willingness to learn
• One (1) to Two (2) years of professional software development experience
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related STEM discipline
• TS/SCI with CI Poly

Preferred:
• Proficiency with Go or another modern programming language
• Understanding of RESTful API design and development
• Exposure to Angular or another modern frontend framework
• Experience with Kubernetes or another container orchestration platform
• Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and GitLab workflows
• Knowledge of Helm charts or infrastructure-as-code tools
• Experience with API gateways such as Traefik or a similar technology
• Exposure to distributed systems concepts
• Familiarity with VS Code or another modern development environment
